newsitem.title: USA: Score Board sees $10 mln savings in 4 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Score Board sees $10 mln savings in 4 yrs.

text.p: Score Board Inc said on Thursday that its player contract restructurings will reduce player liabilities by about $8 million and will result in an expected cash savings of about $10 million over the next four years.
The company said it recently restructured its contracts with Shaquille O'Neal and other Score Board athletes.
Earlier, Score Board reported second quarter net loss per share of $0.86, after an extraordinary gain, compared to $0.14 after a one-time charge a year ago.
